crew_cut.name: Crew Cut
crew_cut.description: A short, easy-to-maintain haircut with closely trimmed sides and back.

bob_hair.name: Bob Hair
bob_hair.description: A short-to-medium cut with a defined shape around the jaw or shoulders.

layered_hair.name: Layered Hair
layered_hair.description: A haircut with graduated lengths that add movement and shape.

bun.name: Bun
bun.description: Hair gathered and secured into an updo at the back or top of the head.

curtain_hair.name: Curtain Hair
curtain_hair.description: A centre-parted style with longer pieces framing both sides of the face.

perm_curls.name: Perm-Style Curls
perm_curls.description: A curly style with added volume and defined bends or curls.

pixie_cut.name: Pixie Cut
pixie_cut.description: A short cropped cut with closely trimmed sides and a shaped top.

pompadour_undercut.name: Pompadour Undercut
pompadour_undercut.description: A full, swept-back top paired with closely trimmed sides.

ponytail.name: Ponytail
ponytail.description: Hair gathered and tied back, leaving the length free to fall.

shag_hair.name: Shag Hair
shag_hair.description: A textured layered cut with a relaxed, tousled finish.

shoulder_length_hair.name: Shoulder-Length Hair
shoulder_length_hair.description: A medium-length cut that falls around the shoulders.

side_part_undercut.name: Side-Part Undercut
side_part_undercut.description: A side-parted top with closely trimmed or shaved sides.

wavy_hair.name: Wavy Hair
wavy_hair.description: Soft waves that add movement and texture through the hair.

exp_butterfly_cut.name: Butterfly Cut
exp_butterfly_cut.description: Butterfly-inspired layers; reviewed previews can appear shorter and bob-like. Preview may change hair color.

exp_wolf_cut.name: Wolf Cut
exp_wolf_cut.description: A bold, spiky interpretation of a choppy wolf cut with a longer back. Preview may change hair color.

exp_korean_two_block.name: Korean Two-Block
exp_korean_two_block.description: A full upper section and dense fringe inspired by the Korean two-block cut. Preview may cover eyes or change hair color.

exp_comma_hair.name: Korean Comma Hair
exp_comma_hair.description: A side-parted, inward-curved fringe inspired by Korean comma hair. Preview may resemble curtain hair, cover eyes or change hair color.

exp_french_bob_wispy.name: Textured French Bob with Wispy Bangs
exp_french_bob_wispy.description: A curly, jaw-length textured bob with separated wispy bangs. Preview may change hair color.

no_makeup_makeup.name: No-Makeup Makeup
no_makeup_makeup.description: Barely visible polish and even tone.

soft_glam.name: Soft Glam
soft_glam.description: Blended eyes and a polished finish.

smoky_glam.name: Smoky Glam
smoky_glam.description: Smoky eyes with a refined base.

dewy_peach.name: Dewy Peach
dewy_peach.description: Fresh peach color and luminous skin.

rosy_pink.name: Rosy Pink
rosy_pink.description: Soft pink eyes, cheeks, and lips.

bronze_golden_glam.name: Bronze / Golden Glam
bronze_golden_glam.description: Warm bronze eyes and golden glow.

matte_nude.name: Matte Nude
matte_nude.description: Muted neutral color with a matte finish.

classic_red_lip.name: Classic Red Lip
classic_red_lip.description: A crisp red lip with simple eyes.

exp_cloud_berry_lips.name: Cloud-Skin Makeup with Blurred Berry Lips
exp_cloud_berry_lips.description: A soft base with diffused berry lip edges and restrained cheek color.

exp_manga_lash.name: Manga-Lash Makeup
exp_manga_lash.description: Separated lash clusters with delicate liner, soft blush, and a restrained lip.

exp_icy_silver.name: Icy Silver Eye Makeup
exp_icy_silver.description: Localized silver-blue eyelid shimmer balanced with subdued cheeks and lips.

french_tip.name: French Tip
french_tip.description: Natural pink nails with white tips.

pink_ombre.name: Pink Ombre
pink_ombre.description: A soft pink gradient toward each tip.

exp_raspberry_jelly.name: Raspberry Jelly
exp_raspberry_jelly.description: A translucent raspberry tint that retains the photographed nail detail.

exp_pink_aura.name: Pink Aura Ombré
exp_pink_aura.description: A soft pink base with deeper pink concentrated near the nail centre.

exp_negative_space_microdots.name: Negative-Space Micro-Dots
exp_negative_space_microdots.description: Sparse dark micro-dots over a lightly tinted natural nail.
